value.syntax: # [doc = " Errors returned from [`run`]."] # [derive (Debug , Error)] pub enum ExecError { # [doc = " An I/O error happened while preparing pipes, writers, or files."] # [error ("io error: {0}")] Io (# [from] io :: Error) , # [doc = " The child process could not be spawned."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " The failing program path remains in the enclosing operation's full public"] # [doc = " arguments under (´[ROOT-rec:output:decision]´); this variant carries the"] # [doc = " underlying error, without duplicating those arguments."] # [error ("failed to spawn child process: {source}")] Spawn { # [doc = " Underlying I/O error."] # [source] source : io :: Error , } , # [doc = " The command vector was empty (no program to run)."] # [error ("empty command")] EmptyCommand , # [doc = " The user requested ambiguous routing for the same file."] # [error ("ambiguous redirection for {path}: configured for multiple routing kinds")] AmbiguousRedirection { # [doc = " Conflicting output path."] path : PathBuf , } , }
